title: Harry Potter: Magic, Jobs & Travel
script: This is an Animagus. This is a Werewolf. So what's the difference? An Animagus is a wizard who can voluntarily transform into an animal. A Werewolf is a human cursed to involuntarily transform under the full moon. This is an Auror. This is a Hit-Wizard. So what's the difference? Aurors are dark wizard catchers for the Ministry. Hit-Wizards are international magical law enforcement. This is Apparition. This is a Portkey. So what's the difference? Apparition is instant self-teleportation. A Portkey is an enchanted object for group travel. Follow for more.
